prompts.leaves: Generate a single animation sprite sheet, 3 columns by 2 rows with equal square cells, showing SIX sequential hand-painted shapes of one dry rusty orange maple leaf tumbling in a gentle autumn breeze. Use the attached cottage painting only as STYLE and PALETTE reference. Isolated leaf only on an entirely uniform pure cyan background #00FFFF, with no shadows on the background, no gradients, no text, no checkerboard. Each cel leaf occupies the center 55% of its cell and has a thin curved stem, delicate dark painted vein marks, rough hand-painted outline. Six different orientations show a believable tumble: flat broad face diagonal, cupped oblique face, thin edge-on, reverse face, opposite oblique, then approaching original broad face. Rich dark red-brown and rusty gold paint matching the reference foreground maple leaves; no bright yellow neon, no photographic leaf. Equal visual scale in all cells; generous margins. This is real changing painted shape, not 6 identical flat leaves simply rotated. No other objects.
prompts.flames: A technical animation atlas of a candle flame ONLY, 4 columns and 2 rows, eight evenly spaced rectangular cells, each containing one small hand-painted pale honey-gold flame with a white-yellow core and dark orange thin edge. Flame base at identical coordinate x50% y80% within each cell, height about45% of cell. Different graceful flame silhouettes across the sequence: upright, lean left, low left curve, upright short, lean right tall, low right curve, upright tall, upright medium. Use expressive storybook painted contours, restrained glow only immediately at the contour. Absolutely solid pure black background across the entire image (#000000), no gradient, no smoke, no candle wax or wick or holder, no reflections, no captions or panel lines. The black background will be converted deterministically into transparent emission. Identical scale, registered base, plenty of margin. The eight changing flame drawings form a quiet continuous combustion cycle.
